competing_explanation: Low reconstruction error could follow from global airlight and beta tokens even if the spatial depth field adds no local information. The permuted-depth control tests that alternative. Passing remains synthetic OTS optical-thickness validity only; it cannot establish a real-haze restoration-demand construct.
controls: reversed filename-token mapping on definition scenes
validation depth fields circularly shifted by 313 independent scenes
exact parent closeout and 964-scene exclusion identities
complete 35-cell official parameter grid per scene
all exclusions and missing cells remain failures under the frozen policy
disabled_actions: transporting the failed indoor q definition or threshold to OTS
calling depth-derived tau real-haze restoration demand or causal mechanism evidence
model, module, loss, threshold, or hyperparameter selection
training, inference, SOTS evaluation, Haze4K outcome evaluation, or NH-HAZE access
treating haze variants, patches, pixels, or depth cells as independent samples
changing sample membership, token roles, permutation, margins, or gates after results

gates.estimand: parent terminal tuple, 964 exclusions, exclusion digest, and 8,006 eligible-scene capacity match
8,970 clear, 8,970 depth, 313,950 haze files, paired scene IDs, and complete 35-cell grids match
A-first-beta-second definition median reconstruction RMSE is at most 0.025 and at most half the reversed-mapping median
independent validation clear scenes with complete measurements

Wilson lower 95 percent bound for validation joint qualification; reconstruction requires scene median RMSE at most 0.025 and scene 95th-percentile RMSE at most 0.050, heterogeneity requires 0.20 times the depth q95-q05 range at least 0.050, and negative control requires permuted-minus-true median RMSE at least 0.005

fixed_factors: eligible scene IDs are the 8,970 official OTS clear IDs minus the exact 964-ID parent exclusion asset
selection is the first 1,000 scene IDs after SHA-256 ordering with salt reside-ots-outdoor-measurement-v1
the first 375 selected scenes are definition and the remaining 625 are validation
each selected scene must contain exactly the full factorial airlight grid 0.80, 0.85, 0.90, 0.95, 1.00 and beta grid 0.04, 0.06, 0.08, 0.10, 0.12, 0.16, 0.20
MATLAB v7.3 depth is read by /usr/bin/octave, aligned to the clear image, and linearly resampled to 96 by 96
clear and haze images are bilinearly resampled to 96 by 96 and normalized to [0,1]
definition compares the preregistered A-first-beta-second token mapping with its reversed alternative; validation always uses A-first-beta-second
the validation negative control circularly shifts the ordered depth list by 313 scenes
no pixel, patch, haze variant, or depth cell is treated as an independent statistical sample
intervention.matched_budget: 375 definition scenes plus 625 validation scenes; all 35 official variants nested within every selected scene; no Haze4K, SOTS, model, or output metric access
intervention.reference: official clear/haze pairing, scalar airlight and scattering coefficient tokens, and a circularly permuted scene-depth negative control

primary_estimand.aggregation: scene-level joint indicator with two-sided Wilson 95 percent interval
primary_estimand.metric: proportion of 625 validation clear scenes simultaneously passing reconstruction, local optical-thickness heterogeneity, and permuted-depth separation

question: On a deterministic scene-disjoint subset of the authorized OTS pool, does the official depth-plus-filename-parameter field reconstruct the official haze variants, retain local spatial heterogeneity, and outperform a permuted-depth negative control with sufficient scene-level coverage and precision?

uncertainty.method: two-sided Wilson 95 percent intervals over independent original clear scenes; variants and pixels are nested summaries only
